title: Better Resource Pack Versioning
description: This mod makes your resource pack to easily support more versions without needing extra meta files.
body:
Better Resource Pack Versioning

Summary

This is a mod which makes resource packs versioning better and more compatible.
* Changes how vanilla resource pack compatibility check works so it won't think your pack is imcompatible or broken. * Makes your resource pack to easily support more versions without needing extra meta files. * Write your pack.mcmeta freely with no more "Broken or incompatible"! * Supports all formats(pack_format, supported_formats, min_format & max_format) in pack.mcmeta * Take a look at the example pack in source repository for more info.

Usage

Download the .jar file and place it into your mods folder like other mods.

Q&A

Q: Will it support other verions?
A: Currently planning to make a Forge/NeoForged version and port it to 1.21.4, 1.21.1, 1.20.1, 1.18.2 and 1.16.5.
